# MaaJanki Web Tech

> MaaJanki Web Tech is a premier website development, AI solutions, and digital marketing agency based in Bihar, India, serving local, national, and global clients across the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, and Nepal. We specialize in high-performance React/Next.js web applications, custom billing software, technical SEO, performance marketing, and branding.

## Services & Core Competencies
- **Web Development:** High-performance, mobile-responsive, SEO-optimized web applications built with Next.js 15, React 18, Node.js, and Tailwind CSS.
- **Search Engine Optimization (SEO):** Technical SEO audits, local SEO, Google Business Profile (GBP) management, AEO, and semantic link building.
- **Performance Marketing:** Data-driven Google Ads (PPC), Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
- **Social Media Optimization (SMO):** Strategic social media management across LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, and X/Twitter.
- **Branding & Visual Identity:** Corporate logo design, brand guidelines, visual identity design, and marketing assets.
- **UI/UX Design:** User-centered wireframing, UI prototyping, and responsive layout design in Figma.
- **Content Writing:** Technical writing, SEO website copywriting, and thought leadership articles.
- **E-Commerce Product Listing:** Catalog optimization for Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Shopify, and WooCommerce.

## Key Products & Software
- **InvoBill:** Hybrid (Offline + Cloud) GST billing & invoicing software tailored for Indian retailers and MSMEs. (Website: https://invobill.in)
- **WaCRM:** WhatsApp Business API CRM with multi-agent inbox and automated routing.
- **DukanDost Pro:** Full-stack Business Operating System with digital khata for modern retail.
- **Nexus SaaS:** AI-powered local reputation management portal connected to Google Business Profile API.
